mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct detached living quarters from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Overall project duration depends on design complexity, municipal permit review times, weather conditions, and site preparation needs. The initial planning, architectural drafting, and permitting phase typically takes several weeks to a few months depending on local building department backlogs. Once permits are issued, physical construction progresses through excavation, foundation pouring, framing, exterior roofing and stucco or siding, rough-in plumbing and electrical, drywall, and interior finishing. A straightforward single-bedroom cottage with simple utility tie-ins moves much faster than a multi-room dwelling requiring substantial grading, retaining walls, or extensive custom tile and cabinetry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Construction timelines depend on permitting speeds, site excavation, utility trenching, and interior finish scope, progressing in distinct phases from design to final inspection.
